verdict.rationale: Deel's REST API and official MCP server expose contracts, people, payroll, and time data, and the MCP tools return structured JSON. That makes programmatic extraction in an open format possible, but this is a DIY route through integration tooling rather than a documented export-and-leave feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, any data-portability or offboarding documentation, confirmation that all data types (documents, payslips, history) can be exported, and independent hands-on evidence of a complete export.
